entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by a UE after requesting release of the EMM context by starting the detach or combined detach procedure and waiting for a response from the MME.

entities.name: Detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE to request release of the EMM context.

entities.name: Combined detach procedure
entities.description: Combined procedure initiated by the UE to request release of the EMM context.

relations.description: Starting the detach procedure causes the UE to enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state.
Starting the combined detach procedure causes the UE to enter the EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state.
